Row.Text: Keeps mod settings across restarts. Civilization VII returns the first stored entry for every settings read, no matter which mod asked, so options panels reset between launches and mods can overwrite each other's settings. This mod keeps every mod's entry inside the one row the game reads correctly and answers all reads and writes from it, in the main menu and in a game. It works with mods that have not been updated for it and has no settings of its own.

Some stored entries sort ahead of the shared settings and the mod cannot tell which mod wrote them, so it is keeping settings in a fallback layout. Rebuilding deletes those entries and writes everything the mod holds back as one entry. All mod settings and keys the mod holds are kept.
{1_Count} stored entries that the mod could not identify will be deleted. All mod settings and keys it holds are kept. This cannot be undone.

A mod tried to store more settings than the store can safely hold. That write was refused and the mod's earlier settings were kept. Every other mod is unaffected. Press for the mod's name and the sizes.

{1_Mod} tried to store settings that would bring the store to {2_Size} MB. The limit is {3_Limit} MB, so that write was refused and the earlier settings were kept. Every other mod is unaffected. Please report this to that mod's author. OK clears this notice.
